name: Graduate Program in Interdisciplinary Biomedical Sciences (GPIBS) PhD
institution: University of Arkansas for Medical Sciences

english.toefl: 79, described as computer-based on the central page; confirm applicable scale
english.note: Central suggested minima; departments may set higher scores. Tests must be within two years preceding the admission semester. Native-English and qualifying US bachelor/master degree exemptions exist. Official reports required.

applicationFee.note: No application fee; no waiver needed.

documents: Statement of purpose: approximately 2 pages or 1,000–1,200 words
Official transcripts for all coursework, including transfer credit
Official foreign transcript evaluation if records are not in English and on a 4.0 scale
Official TOEFL/IELTS scores for applicable international applicants
requirements.note: Strong biological/chemical science preparation preferred; GPA 3.0 equivalent or higher is competitive. Three fall lab rotations before mentor/track selection. Select Biomedical Sciences Doctor of Philosophy in Workday. All materials, letters and scores are due by the deadline.

funding.note: PhD students in good standing receive full tuition remission and an undated published $35,000/year stipend throughout the program. Insurance and fee coverage not established.
